_comment: Extra submission attempts granted by the lecturer, per lab and GitHub login. Logins are matched case-insensitively, as in roster.json; keys starting with _ are ignored. A grant raises that student's submission cap for that lab above the default of three and does nothing else: it never moves a deadline, so a receipt after corrections_due is still late and still does not count. Record why in the lab's _reason. Live fix: push this file; the next issue picks it up, and a refused issue never costs an attempt.

1._reason: Stage 1 of the grader failed between 14:37Z and 15:56Z on Saturday 19 September 2026 and graded submissions against an environment in which no service could start (no report.json, no compose.json, `docker compose up --wait` exiting 1). Every affected issue was regraded between 16:00Z and 16:11Z, but by then students had already spent attempts answering faults that were not theirs. Two extra attempts for each student whose submission was graded inside that window; granted 20 September 2026.
